sections.heading: 75% Practice, 25% Theory
sections.body: Every course at PTI is weighted toward hands-on work. Trainees spend most of their time in the workshop, kitchen, lab, or farm unit — not the classroom — applying skills to real jobs from day one.

sections.heading: Production Units
sections.body: Each department runs a production unit that serves real, paying customers from the public. Trainees work under instructor supervision on live jobs, which also builds customer-care skills alongside the technical trade.

sections.heading: Trade Tests & Dual Certification
sections.body: Training follows two curricula — the Directorate of Industrial Training (DIT) for competence-based skills, and UBTEB for certification. On completion, trainees sit Trade Test Exams under both bodies and graduate with two certificates.

sections.heading: Industrial Attachment
sections.body: After a minimum of 9 months (or sooner, depending on ability), every trainee is placed with an industry or workplace partner for further practical exposure, and receives an industry testimonial on completion.
